title: Law to extend city beach and pool hours and season
summary: This bill would extend the city beach and outdoor pool season to run from the second Saturday in May through the second Sunday in October, instead of ending after Labor Day. It would also extend daily operating hours for beaches and outdoor pools from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m., and require indoor pools to be open at least from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m.
